title: 第775章 以前的事情第775章 圣女的烦恼
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
1415年，奥古斯特帝国，圣塔学院。
那是好多年以前的事情了，距离1424年足足有11年整了。
那会，还是剑与魔法的世界。
14岁后自暴自弃后的林恩，在经历了短短几个月自暴自弃名声糜烂之后，突然再次惊艳了众人的时候。
原本应该是少年正太的金发少年，经过两个月的高强度锻炼后，突然变型为了高大帅气的金发大只佬。
金灿灿的金色秀发打理成了三七分，身姿挺拔，脸部线条完美的如同画里走出。
只不过...这样完美的人，开始抽象了。
在经历了向蕾蒂西娅道歉失败后，又上门找她母亲，然后被西娅的母亲误会，导致蕾蒂西娅过来讨封，然后又在被尤菲抓去当苦力，完成了皇都卫生整改顺手解决瘟疫，还被莉雅与西娅一起从魔族手里救下解决追兵，之后在地下城考试中，林恩与蕾蒂西娅两个人解决地下城的飞龙，但却被众人看见西娅公主抱林恩，而后西娅彻底没招了。
不再理会林恩逃跑之后。
林恩先是葛优躺了一段时间，在系统小猫娘的催促之下，决定先找最亲近之人，青梅竹马莉雅先打看起来简单的关卡那段时间。
林恩感觉自己就好像路边的野狗一样，被众人围观，但他们又不敢上来，发动他们的霸之意志。
于是，自己就成为了野狗，被众人观看，但众人也不敢上来，因为野狗会咬人。
只不过，野狗还是有人投喂的。
林恩嘴里叼着烟，无奈的看着莉雅方向，那是s班在进行治愈术的教学，而莉雅在认真学习之中：“小猫，我们这样真的行吗？”
黄毛吞云吐雾之中，只不过没有持续多久，就要咳嗽起来，不会抽，又重新不学废了。
“当然喵，像这种乖乖女，就需要带她做点刺激的喵。”只有林恩才能看见的小猫，飞在空中，金色长发扎成了两个低马尾，猫耳朵竖起来十分兴奋：“这个你莉莉姆大人我，一定能助你拿下的。”
“这可是你青梅竹马啊，臭杂鱼，你是在质疑我吗？”
“我跟你说，家教严格的乖乖女，想要反抗家庭，不可能自己反抗，就必须要别人帮忙，而如果找个不良少年，就能伪装成被别人欺骗了。”
“到时候，坏名声都是黄毛的，而不是乖乖女的。”
“而且乖乖女的生活里，都是一成不变，甚至于这种认真的还有许多压力呢，所以你要带她做她不敢做的事情，刺激的，违反规矩的，听我，包赢的。”

小猫十分得意忘形，甚至于她的建模是站在了林恩脑袋上。
林恩非常无语，他总感觉不靠谱，因为莉雅是圣女啊，这是普通乖乖女吗？
而且对方要是真乖巧怎么办？
“我说...有没有一种可能，你那个理论只能使用在家教严格的，而莉雅是...嗷~”林恩感觉到大脑吃痛，因为他刚才抬头了。
“变态！萝莉控！杂鱼！不许看！不许看！”小猫面红耳赤的双手敲打林恩脑袋，林恩嫌烦：“哎呀，好了好了。”一把抓起小猫后脖子:“去你的，我试试看。”一脚把人踢进了草丛里。
“系统闭嘴。”林恩在心里吐槽道：“重新装作忧愁的样子，抽着烟。”
系统说，对方可是圣女候补，自然会靠近过来的啦。
加上你是她的青梅竹马，肯定就要关心关心嘛。
然而...“我”已经抽完了一根又一根，结果屁用没有。
反倒还是咳嗽起来了：“咳！咳咳!”
“怎么不吸进去，也能感觉到咳嗽啊？”林恩双眼挤出两行清泪。
“你吸得烟是具有魔力提升效果的烟，自然会这样。”旁边，不知道什么时候尤菲站在了林恩旁边，冷不丁的说了那么一句话后...走了。
林恩嘴角抽搐，望着黑发少女离去的背景，手里拿着一沓文件，而后又看向莉莉姆方向，小猫已经从小猫娘的样子，变成了小猫咪，橘猫。
在哪里玩着球，重新看向莉雅方向，莉雅已经上完课了，看起来有点发懵的望着他林恩，但却迟迟没有过来。
林恩拿不定主意，因为没有经验，匆忙望向莉莉姆蹲下。
“哈！”猫咪突然哈气，发现是林恩后又恢复正常：“怎么了，宿主？”
“刚才的事情，你看见了吧？”林恩脸上写满了谄媚：“系统，这是怎么回事，这道题，我不会做啊。”
“宿主...你就说有没有吸引人来嘛，皇女来了，也算了。”小猫脸不红心不跳，变回幼女小猫娘，理直气壮道：“兴许是你这犹豫的状态...帅到她了，所以她不来。”莉莉姆嘴上比着个猫猫嘴，写满了自信。
然而...事实真是如此吗？
回答几分钟前。

莉雅真正参与治愈术的学习，作为圣女候补，成绩自然很理想，努力，且认真。
莉雅也自然注意到了林恩在抽烟。
content_en:
1415, Augustan Empire, Holy Tower College.
That was many years ago, 11 years ago in 1424.
At that time, it was still the world of swords and magic.
After giving up on herself at the age of 14, Lin En suddenly surprised everyone again after experiencing a few short months of self-destruction and a eroding reputation.
The blond boy who was originally supposed to be a young shota suddenly transformed into a tall and handsome blond guy after two months of intense training.
Her golden hair was styled into three-quarter lengths, her figure was tall and straight, and her face had perfect lines as if she had stepped out of a painting.
It's just...such a perfect person has begun to become abstract.
After failing to apologize to Leticia, she came to see her mother again, and was misunderstood by Thea's mother, causing Leticia to come to ask for a seal. Then she was arrested by Yuffie and worked as a coolie. She completed the sanitation reform in the imperial capital and successfully solved the plague. She was also rescued by Liya and Thea from the demons and defeated the pursuers. Later, in the dungeon exam, Linn and Leticia defeated the flying dragon in the dungeon, but everyone saw Princess Thea hugging Linn, and then Thea was completely out of action.
I ignored Linn after she ran away.
Lin En first lay down with Ge You for a while. Under the urging of the system kitten girl, Lin En decided to find the person closest to him first, his childhood sweetheart Liya. During that time, he first played the seemingly simple levels.
Lin En felt like a wild dog on the roadside, being watched by everyone, but they didn't dare to come up and unleash their domineering will.
So, he became a wild dog and was watched by everyone, but no one dared to come up because wild dogs can bite people.
However, some people still feed wild dogs.
Lin En held a cigarette in his mouth and looked helplessly in the direction of Liya. That was Class S teaching healing techniques, and Liya was studying seriously: "Kitten, is this really okay for us?"
Huang Mao puffed out the mist, but it didn't last long before he started coughing. He couldn't smoke, and he became a loser again.
"Of course, meow. For such a good girl, you need to take her to do some exciting meow." The kitten, which only Linn could see, was flying in the air, with its long blond hair tied into two low ponytails. The cat's ears stood up and she was very excited: "You, Lilim, and I will definitely help you win this."
"This is your childhood sweetheart, you bastard fish. Are you questioning me?"
"Let me tell you, if a good girl with a strict upbringing wants to rebel against her family, she cannot resist on her own. She must ask for help from others. And if she finds a bad boy, she can pretend to be deceived by others."
"When the time comes, the bad reputations will belong to yellow men, not to good girls."
"And the life of a good girl is always the same. Even this kind of seriousness still has a lot of pressure, so you have to lead her to do things that she dare not do, exciting things, and things that violate the rules. Just listen to me, and you are guaranteed to win."
Kitty was so carried away that her model was standing on Linn's head.
Lin En was very speechless. He always felt unreliable because Liya was a saint. Is she an ordinary good girl?
And what if the other person is really well-behaved?
"I said... is there a possibility that your theory can only be used by those who are taught strictly at home, and Liya is... Wow~" Linn felt that his brain was hurting because he raised his head just now.
"Pervert! Lolicon! Don't watch! Don't watch!" The kitten hit Lin En's head with red-faced hands. Lin En was annoyed and said, "Oh, okay, okay." He grabbed the back of the kitten's neck and said, "Fuck you, let me try." He kicked the person into the grass.
"Shut up, the system." Lin En complained in his mind: "Pretend to be sad again and smoke."
The system said that the other party was a candidate for a saint, so he would naturally come closer.
Plus you are her childhood sweetheart, so you must care about her.
However... "I" have finished smokingOne after another, it was useless.
Instead, he started coughing: "Cough! Cough!"
"Why can't you feel the cough even if you don't inhale?" Lin En squeezed out two lines of tears from her eyes.
"The cigarette you smoke is a cigarette that has the effect of increasing magic power, so it will naturally happen like this." Next to him, Yuffie stood next to Linn at some point, said something coldly and then... left.
The corner of Linn's mouth twitched, looking at the background of the black-haired girl leaving, holding a stack of documents in her hand, and then looking in the direction of Lilim. The kitten had changed from a kitty girl to a kitten, an orange cat.
He was playing with a ball somewhere and looked in the direction of Liya again. Liya had already finished her class. She looked at Linn in a daze, but she still didn't come over.
Lin En couldn't make up his mind, and because he was inexperienced, he hurriedly looked at Lilim and squatted down.
"Ha!" The cat exhaled suddenly, then returned to normal after realizing it was Lin En: "What's wrong, host?"
"Did you see what happened just now?" Lin En's face was full of flattery: "System, what's going on? I can't do this question."
"Host... Just tell me if you have attracted people to come. The princess is here, so forget it." The kitten's face turned red and her heart stopped beating. She turned back into a young girl, Kitten Girl, and said confidently: "Maybe it's because of your hesitant state... She's too handsome, so she won't come." Lilim made a cat-like mouth, full of confidence.
However...is this really the case?
Answered a few minutes ago.
Liya really participated in the study of healing arts. As a candidate for a saint, her grades were naturally ideal, she was hard-working and serious.
Liya naturally noticed that Linn was smoking.
